decisions.reason: As a very recent launch with its own webpage, this garage door operator reflects visible public commitment and sunk development effort in a core product area, so management would continue backing it in 2019.

The solid wood sectional garage door broadens the firm's one-source garage offering and, given the fresh investment and no clear evidence of failure yet, management would be inclined to stay the course.
This operator with remote control fits the firm's stated push for improved, customer-near door technology, and escalation of commitment makes an early withdrawal unlikely after launch.

The glazed industrial sectional door is close to the firm's established industrial access business, so recent investment and strategic fit would lead management to retain it despite any early uncertainty.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door supports the firm's compliance- and performance-oriented building solutions range, and management would likely justify and continue the recent commitment.
